context:
Goal: each agent runs the model its role allows, so cost stays where you set it.
Problem (rule): the model table lets only an audit Explore run Sonnet, but the guard cannot tell an audit from a search, so any Explore can run Sonnet today; only you can change the rule.
Based on (read): record agent-model-cap names this point as unruled.
Based on (notes): the Oct 30 incident, a role whose table row says Haiku ran on Sonnet.

options.gain: Closes the Oct 30 class: a search agent can no longer run Sonnet by mistake.
options.how: The guard lets an Explore run Sonnet only when its brief carries an audit marker line; any other Explore runs below Sonnet.
options.label: An audit brief carries a marker line
options.lose: One more line in each audit brief, and a refusal when it is missing.

options.gain: No new line and no new refusal.
options.how: Any Explore may run any model below Opus; the guard does not check.
options.label: Keep the exemption
options.lose: The Oct 30 class stays open: a search can run Sonnet and cost more.

ref: spawn-model-check (#899, the spawn guard checks each agent's model); decision agent-model-cap (model per role)
title: Must an Explore brief that asks for Sonnet say it is an audit?
